newsitem.title: MEXICO: Video Visa says to issue 68 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Video Visa says to issue 68 mln shares.

text.p: Mexican video rentals firm Grupo Video Visa plans to raise capital by issuing 68 million new shares at a price of at least 5 pesos each, local press advertisements said on Monday.

Grupo Video Visa plans to issue the new shares in two tranches. The first tranche of 50 million shares will be offered "within 15 days of the present announcement being published in the (Mexican Government's) Official Gazette," the advertisement said.
The remaining 18 million shares will be offered "at such time as the board decides," the firm added.
